material.$description: Two kinds of glass, both for controls only, never content. 'glass' is a control on a page. 'glass-on-art' is a control floating on artwork (a header illustration, a race lane). Life Hub uses glass for both; After Graduation keeps page controls solid and uses glass only over artwork.

blur-on-art.$description: Light blur behind a control on artwork, so the art still reads clearly through it.

blur-on-art-selected.$description: Frosted glass scatters what is behind it.

refraction-band.$description: How far in from the edge the glass bends the art behind it.

refraction-max.$description: The most a line behind the glass shifts at the edge.

glass.$description: Fill for glass controls and cards.

glass-on-art.$description: Fill for a control floating on artwork, so the art shows through.

glass-on-art-selected.$description: Selected control on artwork. Same as glass on hover.

glass.$description: Inner light along the edges of a glass surface.

glass-on-art.$description: Faint inner glow plus a soft shadow under glass on artwork, so it lifts off busy art.

rim.$description: The lit edge of glass on artwork, instead of a border. Light enters at the top-right and leaves at the bottom-left, easing in and out; the other corners stay dark. Drawn as a conic gradient masked to the rim, adapted from react-glass-rim (MIT). Measured from iOS folder glass.

faint.$description: The rim where it faces away from the light: a faint line, so the glass edge never disappears.

strength.$description: How bright the rim gets where it faces the light (1 is the rim color at full strength).

glint.$description: The faint glint on the far corner, where light leaves the glass.

spread-x.$description: How far the lit part of the rim reaches across the glass.

highlight.$description: Inner highlight along the edge that faces the light.

shade.$description: Inner shade along the edge facing away from the light.

cast.$description: Shadow the glass casts, falling away from the light.

cast-distance.$description: How far the shadow falls from the glass, away from the light.

cast-blur.$description: How soft the cast shadow is.

contact.$description: The tight shadow right under the glass's edge.

lens.$description: Lens glass (Oct 12): action tiles and glass buttons on artwork the design system controls. A WebGL canvas bends the art at the glass's curved edge, never its text. Tuned by Sharon. Used only while the lens is drawing; otherwise the glass keeps the classic recipe above. Matched to the Oct 14 shader demo Sharon approved: a faintly milky body, a bright line on the edge facing the light, the view bending at the round ends, and a soft shadow falling away from the light.

body.$description: No white body in light mode: on the light marble, any white wash reads as frost. Glass shows by its bending and its edge instead.

tint.$description: No tint: like the demo, the glass is clear apart from its faint white body.

rim-width.$description: The lit rim along the glass's edge.

rim-lit.$description: The rim where it faces the light, at its brightest.

rim-faint.$description: The rim everywhere else, so the edge never disappears.

highlight.$description: The band of light just inside the edge that faces the light. Gentle on the light marble, so it never turns into frost.

shadow-color.$description: The shadow the glass casts away from the light (the alpha is its strength).

shadow-distance.$description: How far the shadow falls away from the light. Short, so the glass rests near the page instead of floating high above it.

shadow-blur.$description: How soft the shadow is: tight enough to read as glass close to the surface.

bend.$description: How strongly the edge bends the art (1 is a true rounded bevel).

edge-depth.$description: How far in from the edge the glass curves and bends the art. Never more than 95% of half the glass's height; the middle stays clear.

color-split.$description: A faint color split where the art bends, like real glass.

press-swell.$description: How much the glass swells when pressed, before it settles back.

press-duration.$description: How long the press swell takes to settle back to rest.

tilt-reach.$description: How far tilting a phone moves the light, at most. The light eases back when the phone is still.
